10-year-old Sarbartho Mani 2311 scored his first-ever classical victory against a Grandmaster, defeating GM Dimitris Alexakis (2536) at 1st Chola Chess Open International Grandmasters Chess Tournament 2026. Here are the final moments of his game, and a detailed post-game interview with Sarbartho!
